-- Step 1: Mark the stuck batch task 300001 as failed
UPDATE scheduledTasks 
SET status = 'failed', 
    completedAt = NOW(),
    errorMessage = 'Task stuck at 3994/36123 - force stopped by admin'
WHERE id = 300001 AND status = 'running';

-- Step 2: Clean up all old stuck running tasks (snkrdunk_update type from days ago)
UPDATE scheduledTasks 
SET status = 'failed', 
    completedAt = NOW(),
    errorMessage = 'Stale running task - force cleaned up'
WHERE status = 'running' 
  AND taskType = 'snkrdunk_update'
  AND updatedAt < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR);

-- Step 3: Verify no more running tasks
SELECT COUNT(*) as remaining_running FROM scheduledTasks WHERE status = 'running';
